candidates.title: TASK Memory: Beyond Text-Only Memory with Activation Steering and Knowledge Editing against Memory Hallucination
candidates.venue: arXiv preprint (not yet indexed to a formal venue)
candidates.institution: not formally listed on Semantic Scholar (affiliations field empty); 2 authors (Jin-Kun Zhao, Wen-Jun Wu), no corporate/academic affiliation found in abstract page
communitySignals: not found in HF Daily Papers (checked 2026-11-26, 2026-11-27)
no GitHub/code release link found on abstract page
credibilityEvidence: Table 2: pre-registered test comparisons on Qwen3-8B with 95% paired-bootstrap CI (2000 resamples), hashed train/dev/test splits frozen before any output
5 frozen open models across 4 families (Qwen3-8B/14B, Llama-3.1-8B, Phi-4-14B, Gemma-3-27B)
6 context-use baselines (IKE, CAD, CAA, KSD, ContextFocus, CAST) + 4 parametric-edit baselines (ROME, MEMIT, AlphaEdit, WISE) + Mem0/A-Mem for dialogue
multiple benchmarks: CounterFact, zsRE, LoCoMo, MQuAKE-CF-3k, LongMemEval (oracle, appendix), AppWorld (appendix)
candidates.evidenceMaturityReason: Covers method, pre-registered experimental protocol, multiple baselines and benchmarks, and explicit statistical significance testing; appendix extends to LongMemEval/AppWorld. Does not cover closed/API-only models since the method needs internal activation access.
reproducibilityEvidence: no code or data release link found on the arXiv abstract page or in the fetched body sections
candidates.editorialConfidenceReason: The pre-registered, paired-bootstrap protocol across 5 models/4 families is unusually rigorous for this literature; the three-way hallucination taxonomy (ignoring/misapplying/version-confusion) is cleanly operationalized and the composite metric is well-defined.
candidates.primaryLimitation: 需要讀寫模型內部的 activation 與權重（activation steering + knowledge editing），因此只能用在可存取權重的開源模型，無法套用在只透過 API 呼叫的封閉模型 agent（例如多數生產環境用的 Claude／GPT API）。
candidates.hiddenAssumption: 幻覺類型（memory-ignoring／memory-misapplying／version confusion）由一個自動化的『normalised assertion matcher』判定，而不是人工標註核對每一筆答案。
candidates.hiddenAssumptionImpact: 若 matcher 對否定句或改述偵測有系統性誤差，三種幻覺率的絕對數字會偏；但論文橫向比較（TASK vs. baseline）全部用同一個 matcher 評分，相對排序與統計顯著性的結論仍可信。
candidates.presentationReason: 方法、三種幻覺類型定義、實驗協定與限制範圍都清楚可查；RQ1-RQ3 的組織方式讓讀者容易對應每個數字支持哪個主張。

candidates.title: Contexture: Runtime Context Eviction for High-Throughput Agent Serving

candidates.institution: not-assessed (author byline stripped by content extraction; Semantic Scholar lookup rate-limited — see toolDegradation)

credibilityEvidence: §6.1 Experimental Setup: 2 long-horizon agent benchmarks (Terminal-Bench 2.1, SWE-Atlas-QnA), 2 open-source harnesses (Hermes v2026.10.11, OpenClaw v2026.7.1), 1 dense + 1 MoE model on H200/H100 GPUs via vLLM 0.26
baselines: no eviction, each harness's shipped default compaction, tuned compaction, observation masking, plus two academic runtime-KV/history-editing methods and LMCache
reports throughput-under-SLO, latency slowdown, GPU energy, and live-agent task accuracy together, including the worst-case accuracy loss (not just the favorable mean)
candidates.evidenceMaturityReason: Multi-model, multi-harness, multi-benchmark evaluation against both production-default and academic baselines, with ablation and parameter-sensitivity sections; abstract discloses a worst-case 3.7pp accuracy loss alongside the 1.4pp mean gain, which is a meaningful transparency signal.
reproducibilityEvidence: no code/artifact release link found in the fetched abstract or body sections (may exist in a part of the PDF not fetched — not confirmed either way)
candidates.editorialConfidenceReason: The engineering claim (throughput/energy gains under SLO) is well supported by a broad, realistic evaluation matrix; confidence is capped at medium rather than high because reproducibility is unconfirmed and the worst-case accuracy regression (3.7pp) means the safety margin for correctness is not free.

candidates.hiddenAssumption: 判定『某個 tool 呼叫的舊輸出已被後續操作取代（supersession），可以安全移除』這個規則本身足以代表『這段歷史之後真的不會再被需要』。
candidates.hiddenAssumptionImpact: 如果取代判定錯誤或任務需要回頭引用被判定為『已取代』的舊輸出，就是 worst-case 準確率下降的來源；論文已經測到並揭露這個下降幅度，但沒有進一步分析哪種任務型態最容易踩到這個前提失效的情況。
candidates.presentationReason: 系統設計（supersession 追蹤、全域 KV 壓力狀態、cache-aware commit policy）章節分明，評測指標（throughput/energy/accuracy）分開報告而不是合成一個分數，容易看出 trade-off 在哪裡。

4 case studies showing the specific harness edits found and the failure mechanisms they address
candidates.evidenceMaturityReason: Validated on exactly one base memory system (ReMe) across two benchmarks; the mechanism generalizes across benchmark scale but has not been shown to generalize to a different underlying memory architecture, and the 'structural improvement' judgment is made by an LLM-based diagnoser agent whose own diagnostic accuracy is not independently verified.

candidates.reason: 與入選的 TASK Memory（5 模型 4 家族、pre-registered 統計檢定）、MGMem（3-seed 重跑+程式碼公開）、Contexture（2 模型 2 harness 2 benchmark 的生產級評測）相比，HoMe 只在單一基礎記憶系統（ReMe）上驗證，證據廣度較窄；方向本身紮實，適合在有更多基礎系統驗證後重新考慮。

candidates.title: Epistemic Guard: Out-of-Process MCP Receipt Proxying, Post-Turn Prose Supervision, and Provenance-Gated Memory for Tool-Using Autonomous Agents
candidates.institution: independent developer (submitter Sean Maxwell; no institutional affiliation found)
communitySignals: not found in HF Daily Papers (checked 2026-11-26, 2026-11-27)

candidates.evidenceMaturityReason: All headline numbers come from conformance suites and benchmark sets the single author appears to have designed themselves (200 leaves, 58/58, 50/50, N=250, N=60 are all small, self-constructed test sets); the repeated exact round numbers (多個 100.0%) read as marketing framing rather than independently adjudicated evaluation, and there is no third-party or adversarial red-team validation.
reproducibilityEvidence: code is open-source on GitHub, but the evaluation/benchmark construction itself is not independently verified
candidates.editorialConfidenceReason: The problem framing (action fabrication, provenance collapse, syndicated echo amplification in MCP tool-using agents) is real and relevant, but the evidence is self-graded by the same author who built both the tool and its test suite.
candidates.primaryLimitation: 所有「100%」與高準確率數字都建立在作者自建的 conformance suite 上，沒有第三方對抗測試或獨立複現；作者身分為獨立開發者，沒有機構背書或同行審查。
candidates.hiddenAssumption: 作者自建的 conformance suite（如 200 個 Merkle leaves、58/58 AER-1 向量）能代表真實世界中 MCP 工具呼叫的攻擊面與失敗模式分佈。
candidates.hiddenAssumptionImpact: 如果測試集對自己的方法天然友善（self-constructed test harness 常見的問題），多個 100% 的數字可信度會大幅降低；核心問題（action fabrication / provenance collapse）仍是真實存在的風險，但目前證據不足以判斷方法有效性超出作者自己的宣稱。
candidates.presentationReason: 技術細節（Ed25519、RFC 6962 Merkle log、OpenVINO INT8 encoder）描述具體，但摘要堆疊大量精確到小數點的數字，缺少對照『這些數字為什麼可信』的獨立驗證說明。
candidates.reason: 主題（agent 工具呼叫的 provenance 與記憶寫入治理）切中時事，但所有量化結果來自作者自建的 conformance suite，缺少第三方驗證；若日後有外部稽核或獨立複現數據，可重新考慮。
